_install_claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http github https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_PAT}"
_note: In Claude Code the gh CLI is usually cheaper on context. Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to specific repos. Limit toolsets (X-MCP-Toolsets header for remote, --toolsets flag for local) to cut context cost.
